audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side values disagreed with the content layer's win[N] and with the packet levelChart.
audit.why: Packet and win[] both read Diana / Diana / Neeko / Diana / Diana / Diana / Diana; the full layer read Neeko / Neeko / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Skill / Skill. Level 3 is genuinely hers: Tangle-Barbs roots from 1000 on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 while Lunar Rush is 18s at rank 1 without a Moonlight mark.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to the content layer, every why rewritten in the same proposal to match its new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom was described as a root that 'roots and stuns the whole team'. It is a leap that knocks up, then stuns on landing, 120/105/90 at 600 range.
audit.why: Riot's text: after a short preparation Neeko leaps, knocking up nearby enemies; on landing they are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.corrected: Her real spike is a 120-second telegraph you can see unless she is disguised; yours are Lunar Rush at 3, Moonfall at 6 (100/90/80) and first item.
sources: brief enemyKit Neeko R and P

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to sidestep Tangle-Barbs 'behind minions'. The tangle roots everything it passes through, so the wave does not stop it — and it grows larger, faster and longer-rooting after passing a champion.
audit.why: Riot's text for Tangle-Barbs. Standing behind the wave is the exact position that gets you rooted, and a root removes Diana's dash window entirely.
audit.corrected: Sidestep wide, not behind the wave; the tangle passes through minions and only gets worse after clipping a champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Inherent Glamour was never named and its concrete threat never stated.
audit.why: Neeko can look like an ally champion; the disguise breaks on immobilizing CC, on casting damaging spells, or when it takes damage equal to its healthbar. Diana's Q reveals what it strikes for 3 seconds.
audit.corrected: Q an approaching 'ally' you did not expect — Moonlight reveals, and a damaging cast breaks the disguise anyway.

audit.why: 53.15% over 922 games supports the 7/10 TRICKY framing.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Pale Cascade for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

notes: CHART: all seven full-layer sides disagreed with win[] and the packet. win[] already matched the packet, so only phases[N].side moved, each with its why rewritten in the same proposal; no win[N] edit is proposed because win[N] already holds the target value and a before==after edit would be rejected. Left alone as unverifiable from the kits: whether Neeko's disguise can copy a ward or minion specifically (Riot says 'an ally champion or as other units on the map', which is not specific enough to assert), and whether Diana's Q reveal breaks the disguise by itself as opposed to the damage doing it.
